dct_description_sm: The primary objective of this project is to monitor impacts on Nuiqsut caribou hunting and in doing so to facilitate and maintain communication between the study team, Nuiqsut residents and organizations.  The Nuiqsut caribou monitoring project is designed to monitor and understand the potential problems that have been reported by North Slope hunters.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Traditional diet
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Hunting
dct_title_s: Nuiqsut Caribou Subsistence Monitoring Project, North Slope, Alaska
